# Hamid Ettefagh

> Personal site of Hamid Ettefagh, Distinguished Forward Deployed Engineer at Salesforce, based in Los Angeles. He designs, builds, and ships production agent systems for the enterprise: multi-agent platforms, RAG pipelines, and the evaluation and observability layers that make them safe to run at scale. The site's through-line: production over demos, and reach for reasoning on purpose, not by default.

## Method

- [The two gates](https://hamidettefagh.com/two-gates): the write-up behind everything on this site. A design gate decides what to build, a ship gate proves it is ready, and an incident-to-eval loop turns production failures into regression tests.

## Interactive tools

- [Agent, or workflow?](https://hamidettefagh.com/agent-architecture): the design gate. Answer seven questions about a use case and get a deterministic verdict: workflow, hybrid, single model call, single agent with tools, or multi-agent. Includes an Agentforce lens that renders the same verdict in Flows, prompt templates, Agent Script, and topics.
- [Agent production readiness](https://hamidettefagh.com/agent-production-readiness): the ship gate. Score a built agent across seven dimensions (evaluation, cost, observability, guardrails, human oversight, reliability, governance) before go-live.
- [Incident to eval](https://hamidettefagh.com/incident-to-eval): turn a production agent incident into a portable regression eval case, validated by the same rules as the incident-to-eval skill.

## MCP server

- Endpoint: https://hamidettefagh.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no sign-in; serves the 2026-07-28 revision and 2025-era clients). Tools: design_gate, ship_gate_checklist, ship_gate_score, validate_eval_case, site_agent_evals. All deterministic, read-only, no model inside. Docs: https://hamidettefagh.com/lab/mcp
- Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http two-gates https://hamidettefagh.com/api/mcp

## Lab

- [Lab](https://hamidettefagh.com/lab): experiments run in the open, each with a status, a question, and a result.
- [Evals for this site's agent](https://hamidettefagh.com/lab/site-agent-evals): the ask widget's golden set, every answer and every check from the latest recorded run against production.
- [A voice agent's latency budget](https://hamidettefagh.com/lab/voice-latency): an interactive breakdown of one voice agent turn, stage by stage, from published ranges.
- [How this site is built](https://hamidettefagh.com/how-its-built): the site run through its own two gates, including the site agent's ship gate score with every gap listed.

## Open source

- [two-gates plugin](https://github.com/hamidettefagh/two-gates): the whole method as one installable Claude Code plugin. Install with /plugin marketplace add hamidettefagh/two-gates, then /plugin install two-gates@hamidettefagh. Also listed in Anthropic's plugin directory: search two-gates under Discover in the Claude apps.
- [agent-or-workflow](https://github.com/hamidettefagh/agent-or-workflow): the design gate as a Claude skill with a deterministic verdict engine.
- [agent-production-readiness](https://github.com/hamidettefagh/agent-production-readiness): the ship gate as a Claude skill with a 28-check rubric.
- [incident-to-eval](https://github.com/hamidettefagh/incident-to-eval): turns a production agent incident into a portable, validated eval case.

## Case studies

- [Multi-agent customer operations platform](https://hamidettefagh.com/work/airline-super-agent): how a major US airline's production customer service agent survived the launch failure that nearly ended it, and the multi-agent architecture he designed for its next stage and is now building.
- [Service agents for a two-sided marketplace](https://hamidettefagh.com/work/dining-platform-agents): how a global dining platform's two production agents stopped promising customers a transfer that could not happen, by computing escalation from business hours and real availability before the model reasons.
